segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Given the deadline pressure, I don't have time to deep-dive every file equally, so I lean on signals like that to triage.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: General triage rationale without the later school-reputation spillover mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I fast-tracked it to interview. Honestly, the school's reputation carried a lot of weight for me there — a slightly low test score didn't worry me much.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: School reputation discounted a below-threshold score and substituted a favorable category assumption for case-specific checking.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I noted the late arrival and the rocky start on the rubric as a composure concern ... I was aware the strike was happening citywide.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Dispositional inference was made while the situational transit disruption was known.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If I'd had that transit confirmation in hand during the interview instead of afterward, I probably would have framed the early hesitation as circumstantial.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Retrospective correction acknowledgement; hidden decision is localized to earlier scoring.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I framed it as the kind of thing that shows a student worked through something ... extra confirmation rather than something to weigh independently.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The disciplinary note was assimilated into and strengthened the prior favorable narrative.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I used our standard conversion table, even knowing it wasn't built for the reformed scale and would probably lowball the actual grades.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A familiar conservative default was chosen despite acknowledged uncertainty and available alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I found myself giving the network-affiliated finalist a bit more benefit of the doubt ... I probably held the other finalist to a slightly tighter standard.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Shared network membership produced unequal discretionary standards.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I can't rule out that the tie mattered more than it should have.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Qualified retrospective reflection adjacent to, but not itself, the mapped comparative weighting.
